provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: the Cour de cassation's open-data CGU on PISTE (version of 6 January 2022). Quotas per second / minute / day, on the number of requests or the bandwidth, for the whole application or one method, are shown only in the PISTE application's 'Consulter les quotas': no public figure, so null. Access needs a PISTE account and OAuth 2.0 credentials (or the application's KeyId). Licence Ouverte 2.0 (commercial use allowed) with the CGU's obligations: name the source (the Cour de cassation's Open Data base, a hyperlink allowed) and the date of the data's last update, with each decision its court, date and number; no alteration; keep the data up to date (recommended at most 72 hours between two updates) and drop decisions flagged to_be_deleted; report any re-identifying element to anonymisation.sder.courdecassation@justice.fr; the identity of judges and clerks must never be used to evaluate or predict their practice.
